name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Cedric and Edmund, one goes with Carpenter and the other with Fletcher.
Edmund goes with none of Carpenter, 11 coins, or 12 coins.
At most two of Aldric, Rowan, the artisan with 8 coins, and the artisan with 9 coins belong to the Clothiers' Guild.

Aldric's levy is lower than both the Blacksmith and the Tanner.
Exactly one of (the members of the Ironmongers' Guild, Aldric, and Wulfric) goes with (12 coins or 8 coins).
